'''Ocera''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served as one of the masters of [[Ashara Zavros]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was killed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] when he and [[Ryen]] engaged a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], but they were easily defeated.

Unlike his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] peers, he used a rare white [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] to enlighten his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
